title.zh: 黑体辐射 · 热的物体为什么发光
title.en: Blackbody Radiation · Why Hot Things Glow

desc.zh: 温度越高，颜色从红变白再变蓝；经典理论在紫外一端失败，普朗克的“能量一份一份”把它救了回来。
desc.en: Hotter things glow from red to white to blue; classical theory fails in the ultraviolet, and Planck’s idea that energy comes in lumps rescues it.
